topic: Side income from home in my 70s: markets, mini-facials, home parties
text:
Side hustle posts are everywhere this week.

Here's mine, in my 70s on the Sunshine Coast:
A table at the local market.
Mini-facials where you apply it yourself while I guide you.
A few home parties with friends.

No get-rich promises. Just real skin, real people, steady work.
picture_tip: Your market table set up at Trail Bay or Sunnycrest, products lined up, your hands in frame. 4:5.
video_tip: 8s pan across the market table, ending on a customer's hands trying product. On-screen text: 'My side income in my 70s'.
